related.title: IBM 低溫 QPU：熱光子佔據與溫度尺度
related.titleEn: IBM cryogenic QPU: thermal photon occupation and temperature
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：逐項標記通過、失敗或資料不足，不以熟悉品牌代替證據。最終交接必須包括：交付逐級熱帳、線數敏感度與接觸故障辨識圖。 所有通過結論只在本課明列假設內成立。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Mark each item pass, fail or insufficient evidence; a familiar brand is not proof. Final handover must include: Deliver stage-specific thermal ledgers, line-count sensitivity and contact-fault discrimination. Every pass remains conditional on the stated teaching assumptions.
related.difference: 建立『IBM 低溫 QPU：熱光子佔據與溫度尺度』可核算的名義與變更模型，區分實際來源背景、合成輸入及驗收證據。成果：交付無量綱指數、兩溫度佔據與溫度計／模式溫度區分表。
related.differenceEn: Build reproducible nominal and changed models for 'IBM cryogenic QPU: thermal photon occupation and temperature', separating sourced context, synthetic inputs and acceptance evidence. Outcome: Deliver dimensionless exponents, occupations at both temperatures and thermometer/mode-temperature distinctions.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：穩態餘量M=Q可用−Q固定−Nq線；所有項需對應同一溫度級，不混合4 K與混合室能力。 使用全為教學值：同一級可用20 μW，固定5 μW，每線0.05 μW，N=200。 以手算或試算表計算名義式20-5-200*0.05，另開一欄執行獨立核對：以總負載加餘量應等20 μW檢查；分別列靜態傳導、主動耗電與RF耗散避免漏算。

先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：玻色模式n̄=1/(exp(hf/kBT)−1)；這是平衡模式佔據，不直接等於兩能階激發概率。 使用教學f=5 GHz，T=20 mK；h=6.62607015×10⁻³⁴、kB=1.380649×10⁻²³ SI。 以手算或試算表計算名義式1/(exp(6.62607015e-34*5e9/(1.380649e-23*0.020))-1)，另開一欄執行獨立核對：先檢查無量綱x=hf/(kBT)，再用低佔據exp(−x)交叉比較近似誤差。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: Steady margin M=Qavailable−Qfixed−Nqline; all terms must refer to the same thermal stage, not mixed4 K and mixing-chamber ratings. Use All teaching values: one stage offers20 μW, fixed load5 μW, each line0.05 μW and N=200. Evaluate nominal expression 20-5-200*0.05 by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Check total load plus margin equals20 μW; list static conduction, active power and RF dissipation separately.

Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: A bosonic mode has n̄=1/(exp(hf/kBT)−1); equilibrium mode occupation is not identical to two-level excitation probability. Use Teaching f=5 GHz and T=20 mK; h=6.62607015×10⁻³⁴ and kB=1.380649×10⁻²³ in SI. Evaluate nominal expression 1/(exp(6.62607015e-34*5e9/(1.380649e-23*0.020))-1) by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Check dimensionless x=hf/(kBT), then compare the low-occupation approximation exp(−x).
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: 超導陣列設計：頻率碰撞與良率代理
related.titleEn: Superconducting array design: frequency collisions and yield proxy
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：逐項標記通過、失敗或資料不足，不以熟悉品牌代替證據。最終交接必須包括：交付逐級熱帳、線數敏感度與接觸故障辨識圖。 所有通過結論只在本課明列假設內成立。

related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：穩態餘量M=Q可用−Q固定−Nq線；所有項需對應同一溫度級，不混合4 K與混合室能力。 使用全為教學值：同一級可用20 μW，固定5 μW，每線0.05 μW，N=200。 以手算或試算表計算名義式20-5-200*0.05，另開一欄執行獨立核對：以總負載加餘量應等20 μW檢查；分別列靜態傳導、主動耗電與RF耗散避免漏算。
先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：若M個危險配對獨立、每對碰撞率p，無碰撞代理Y=(1−p)^M；真實頻率誤差通常相關。 使用教學M=20、p=0.02；把配對風險與晶片逐量子位元良率分開。 以手算或試算表計算名義式(1-0.02)**20，另開一欄執行獨立核對：用1−Y求至少一次碰撞機率；再用Mp的聯集上界作合理性檢查而非精確等式。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: Steady margin M=Qavailable−Qfixed−Nqline; all terms must refer to the same thermal stage, not mixed4 K and mixing-chamber ratings. Use All teaching values: one stage offers20 μW, fixed load5 μW, each line0.05 μW and N=200. Evaluate nominal expression 20-5-200*0.05 by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Check total load plus margin equals20 μW; list static conduction, active power and RF dissipation separately.

Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: For M independent risky pairs with collision probability p, collision-free proxy Y=(1−p)^M; real frequency errors can be correlated. Use Teaching M=20 and p=0.02; distinguish pairwise collision risk from per-qubit fabrication yield. Evaluate nominal expression (1-0.02)**20 by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Use1−Y for at least one collision; check against union bound Mp without treating the bound as equality.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
